eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Boundary; Bonner; Kootenai; Shoshone; Benewah, ID; at 8:06 PM on AUG 30, 2025 Effective until 10:06 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the Endangered Missing Person Alert system.  The Bonner County Sheriff's Office is looking for a missing person who was last seen at 10 A.M. on Friday August 29th in the area of Karebear Lane North Sandpoint Idaho and is believed to be in danger. She is a 16 year old 5 foot 1 inch tall female weighing about 97 Pounds with black hair and brown eyes. She was last seen wearing a Black Tank Top Black Shorts and black and white slip on shoes. If you have any information on the where abouts of this missing person please contact 9  1  1 immediately.
